s479.lawyer_check: to be checked by a lawyer
s479.not_automatic: Release is not automatic. The jail superintendent must apply to the court (the person or their lawyer can also apply), and the court decides.
s479.reason.death_or_life: This offence can be punished with death or life imprisonment, so Section 479 does not apply. Ordinary bail can still be sought.
s479.reason.table_no: The sentence table says Section 479 does not apply to this offence.
s479.reason.other_cases: More than one case is pending, so Section 479 release is not available (Section 479(2)). Ordinary bail can still be sought.
s479.reason.many_sections: More than one section is charged. Section 479(2) may bar release, so these dates are to be checked by a lawyer.
s479.reason.question: This question is not answered yet: "{question}" The maximum term may be different, so these dates are to be checked by a lawyer.
s479.reason.table_check: The sentence table flags this offence for checking{notes}. These dates are to be checked by a lawyer.
s479.reason.delay: {days} days of delay caused by the accused are not counted, so both dates move later by that many days.
s479.max.no_date_same: The offence date is not given, but the IPC and BNS maximums are the same.
s479.max.no_date_differs: The offence date is not given. The maximum is different under the IPC (offences before 1 July 2024), so the dates are to be checked by a lawyer.
s479.max.after_july: The offence happened on or after 1 July 2024, so the BNS maximum is used: only offences committed before 1 July 2024 use the old IPC maximum.
s479.max.before_no_ipc: The offence happened before 1 July 2024, but our sentence table has no IPC maximum for this offence, so the BNS maximum is shown and the dates are to be checked by a lawyer.
s479.max.before_ipc: The offence happened before 1 July 2024, so the IPC maximum is used: Article 20(1) of the Constitution bars a heavier penalty than the law in force when the offence happened.
s479.max.bns_higher: (The BNS maximum, {months} months, is higher and does not apply.)
s479.note.convicted: Only for a person never convicted of any offence before.
s479.note.part_month: Part of a month is counted as 30 days; to be checked by a lawyer.
s479.error.delay_negative: Delay caused by the accused can't be negative.
s479.error.custody_after_today: The date custody began can't be after today's date.
s479.error.offence_after_custody: The offence date can't be after the date custody began.
